helper.name: collect_v4_usage.py
helper.portability: External helper uses fixed local repository/provider-state locations. Neither helper nor private raw logs are packaged; published rules, hashes and counts are audit metadata, not self-contained usage reproduction.

scope: Explicit completed own v4 cells only; no providers, settings changes or unrelated project log scans. Primary report usage remains null.
codexMethod: Read-only state_5 exact thread-ID lookup, or exact own cwd variants for direct. Confirm SQLite cwd and rollout session_meta ID/cwd. Aggregate last cumulative total_token_usage once per thread, not summed cumulative events.
claudeMethod: Exact workspace-encoded project directory only. Require log stem session ID plus exact-root anchor and native thread ID when recorded. Include resolved owned root and descendants, exclude sibling/escape paths. Deduplicate sessionId/message.id; conflicting duplicate counters fail collection.
tokenSemantics: Claude input_tokens excludes cache; add cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens once for inclusive input.
Codex cached input is a subset of input_tokens; reasoning output is a subset of output_tokens. Never add subsets twice.
Absent counters remain null; zero requires explicit source data.
PM/judge native_usage covers successful responses only; ClaudeCliProvider input already includes cache reads/writes. Failed/unreported usage is unknown.
No cost, billing-complete combined total or API-call count is inferred.

v4_04Correction.reason: Exact-root-only filter omitted 12 assistant entries representing 5 additional unique messages in the same owned session after cwd changed to src. Descendant inclusion corrects counting without widening project/session scope.

limitations: Claude effort is requested configuration, not independently observed in these usage records.
Session observations cannot establish unlogged failed request usage or billing completeness.
Distinct message count is not a billable API-call count.
